pages.text: Several mods add the same metal. Recipes usually ask for a $(thing)tag$() ("any steel ingot"), so any mod's version works. The items look alike but don't stack together.$(br2)Full list: $(l:materials/shared_metals)Shared Metals$(/l).

$(li)$(bold)Steel$(): Alloyed, TFMG, Create Nuclear and Big Cannons all make it, and all count as steel$(li)$(bold)Lead$(): only Create Nuclear's lead ore generates (TFMG's is switched off), and both mods' lead ingots count

$(li)$(bold)Titanium$(): ore only on Northstar's planets, but you can make it on Earth by crushing limestone or sand into Rutile and running an assembly line$(li)$(bold)Platinum$(): a Create Propulsion ore, needed for vector thrusters

$(li)$(bold)Zinc$(): Create's metal, needed for brass. Productive Bees can make zinc and lead bees too.$(br2)Crushing ores with Create gives more metal per block. See $(l:materials/ore_doubling)Ore Doubling$(/l).
